name: accordion
title: Accordion
summary: A stack of sections that open and close, one at a time or several.
description: A stack of disclosures where the rows know about each other: one open at a time (or several with multiple), arrow keys move between the headers. Each item is the collapsible's row (44px trigger, the right caret that turns down, the same reveal), with a hairline between items; plain on the page or in one card. Behaviour and ARIA from the Zag accordion machine through Ark UI.

anatomy.description: Ark's accordion root; data-orientation=vertical. plain: no surface. card: one surface card (radius.card, shadow.card) that clips its rows.
One disclosure (Ark's item, a collapsible root): data-state=open|closed, data-disabled. A 1px line under every item but the last.

The collapsible's row trigger (the classes of collapsible.trigger, variant row): 44px minimum, padding 10, hover fill hover, press hover-2, focus ring inside. aria-expanded, aria-controls, data-state from the engine; native disabled.
The collapsible's caret: right caret (ph caret-right) that turns down 90deg while the item is open, mirrored right-to-left; first or last child of the trigger; aria-hidden; kbd-instant.
The item's heading text: 14px/500 ink, wraps (never cut); its first line shares the caret's 24px line. Author text keeps its own direction.
Trailing quiet note in the trigger (12px ink-2), never wraps.
role=region, aria-labelledby its trigger; the collapsible's region (grid rows 0fr to 1fr). Closed: hidden, out of the layout and the tab order.
The one child of the region; it clips while the region moves. Holds the detail text, then the item's free content.
The item's detail text: 12px ink-2, inset to line up with the label (padding 0 10px 10px).

items.description: The items in order: { value, label, meta?, detail?, disabled? }. Free content in an item's body, after the detail text: React, the item's content (a node); Vue, the content slot; Svelte, the content snippet (both receive the item).

value.description: The values of the open items. React: value / defaultValue / onValueChange; Vue: v-model:value; Svelte: bind:value.

multiple.description: Several items may be open at once. Without it, opening one closes the other.

collapsible.description: The open item closes when its trigger is pressed again. false: one item always stays open once one has been opened (single mode only).

variant.description: plain: rows on the page, hairlines between them. card: the rows in one surface card (the task-rows list look).

caret.description: Where the caret sits in each trigger, as the collapsible.

disabled.description: Every item is disabled (an item can be disabled on its own with its disabled field).

events.valueChange: (value: string[]) the open items, after a click, Enter or Space

keyboard: Tab reaches the triggers one by one; nothing inside a closed item is reachable
Enter / Space toggle the focused item; the change is instant (no reveal, no caret turn)
ArrowDown / ArrowUp move focus to the next / previous trigger; Home / End to the first / last
A disabled item's trigger is skipped by Tab and by the arrows
notes: Each trigger is a real button whose whole content is its name; each region is labelled by its trigger.
A closed region leaves the layout once its exit has played, which also takes it out of the accessibility tree.
Set it from outside by controlling value (React value / onValueChange).

motion: the collapsible's: reveal grid-template-rows 0fr -> 1fr over duration.reveal easing.out-strong with opacity over duration.base; the items below move with it
exit: the same transition back, held by fndn-collapsible-exit before the region is hidden; in single mode the item that closes and the one that opens move at the same time
trigger hover and press fills over duration.fast (hover gated to a fine pointer)
keyboard: region and caret are instant (kbd-instant)
